_note: Synthetic, non-6c room written from scratch for #97's review (not copied from carcass.json, no book text): a crypt nave with a sealed sarcophagus (a ghoul inside), a vestment chest, and an unfound trapdoor (a skeleton below), plus a sexton in the vestibule. SRD 5.1 Ghoul, Skeleton and Commoner stat lines (runtime/srd_creatures.py). Data only. Stat lines are written out inline with the SRD numbers (runtime/srd_creatures.py lists the same creatures for rooms that cite them by name).

nave.name: Crypt nave
nave.arrival: Someone comes in under the arch.

labels.nave: A low arch opens on the vestibule.
labels.vestibule: The low arch leads back into the nave.

sarcophagus.text: A stone sarcophagus stands in the middle of the nave, its lid sealed with old wax.

handling.look: The wax seal is cracked along one edge.
handling.move: The lid grinds a hand-width aside.
handling.handle: Cold stone and brittle wax under your fingers.

amulet.text: A tarnished amulet rests on the bones inside.

chest.text: A vestment chest sits against the wall beside the sarcophagus.

handling.move: The chest scrapes a foot along the flagstones.

flagstones.text: Worn flagstones pave the nave; one near the wall sits a finger lower than the rest.

trapdoor.text: A trapdoor of fitted stone is set in the floor by the wall.

handling.look: An iron ring is sunk in the stone.
handling.move: The trapdoor groans up on a black shaft.

bench.text: A sexton's bench, with a lantern on it.

stat_block._srd: SRD 5.1 Ghoul (the claws: one attack a turn)

sexton.name: Old sexton
sexton.motive: Keep strangers out of the crypt.

trapdoor.truth: A stone trapdoor is set in the floor by the wall.

triggers.reveal: Grey fingers curl over the rim of the sarcophagus and a ghoul hauls itself out.
A skeleton in rotted mail climbs out of the shaft, sword first.
